translation: Multiply wash me ⟨from⟩ my iniquity, and ⟨from⟩ my sin purify me

tokens.notes: Hapax reading - the verb רבה here likely carries the sense of 'make much/abundant' in a ritual context, i.e. wash thoroughly
HAPAX - from root כבס meaning to trample, hence to wash by stomping; ritual washing language
Preposition מן meaning 'from' prefixed to עון (iniquity)
HAPAX - piel imperative of טהר (be pure), ritual purification language
